header.name: Robot going for a stroll V05
header.description: The frisbee moves to the banana hand. Adds the robot cape (Quick Detail "Robot Cape"): a sheet that ripples down its length, and flows more in tight turns. Cape is a visibility group. Walks the loop from Quick Detail "Robot Loop" (3c4c380d-7901-4944-8929-d74e92903789).
